links.outcome: Association between patient trust in AI medication information and acting without verification
links.effect: Increasing trust was associated with higher behavioral risk, including acting on AI-generated medication advice without verification (P=0.002).
links.quote: Increasing trust was associated with higher behavioral risk, including acting on AI-generated medication advice without verification (P=0.002).

unlisted_practices: Pharmacist-led verification of AI-generated medication information as a safety barrier (patient expectations/support measured)

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of patients assessing trust, verification behaviors, and views on pharmacist involvement regarding AI-generated medication information.
